summary: Calculate the pointwise firehose margin B^2/mu0 + p_perp - p_parallel in Pa for anisotropic pressure and magnetic-field samples, with no derivative, no mirror branch and no stability flag.

identity.relation: Anisotropic pressures and magnetic-field samples to the pointwise firehose margin only
identity.definition: firehose_margin = B^2/mu0 + p_perp - p_parallel, evaluated independently at every sample in Pa. No sample-to-sample relation of any kind is used: no sorting, no derivative, no minimum reduction and no aggregate flag. A single sample or a set of all-equal B values is as valid as any other input of the same shape.
identity.model: The local fluid (CGL-ordering) firehose discriminant written in pressure units; positive values at samples are arithmetic observations, not a stability label, not a complete firehose criterion (gradient, kinetic and finite-Larmor corrections are outside this relation), and never a mirror-instability statement
identity.geometry: No spatial grid geometry is used; array dimensions preserve sample layout only
identity.coordinates: The margin is computed elementwise in the given sample layout; no coordinate is derived from the samples
identity.boundary: Empty sample sets are rejected. B^2/mu0 that overflows float64 makes the margin nonfinite and is rejected. No duplicate-B rule exists because no cross-sample quantity is formed.
assumptions: p_parallel and p_perp are pressure values in Pa sampled consistently with B in tesla.
The caller decides what physical interpretation, if any, a positive or negative margin value has for its state; this asset asserts no criterion.

inputs.name: p_parallel
inputs.shape: nonempty scalar or array; exactly the same shape as p_perp and magnetic_field
inputs.constraints: Finite; negative values are not rejected.

inputs.name: p_perp
inputs.shape: exactly the same shape as p_parallel
inputs.constraints: Finite; negative values are not rejected.

inputs.name: magnetic_field
inputs.description: Magnetic-field samples for the B^2/mu0 term, the magnetic-tension contribution in pressure units (SI magnetic pressure itself is B^2/(2*mu0), a different quantity).
inputs.shape: exactly the same shape as p_parallel
inputs.constraints: Finite; duplicate or all-equal values are accepted because no cross-sample quantity is formed.

inputs.name: mu0
inputs.description: Magnetic permeability used in the B^2/mu0 term.
inputs.constraints: Scalar; array or sequence values are rejected before arithmetic (a non-scalar mu0 would broadcast against the sample shape). Finite and strictly positive; the default is 4*pi*1e-7.

outputs.name: firehose_margin
outputs.constraints: Finite on successful return; no sign is interpreted, clamped or flagged.

preconditions: Both pressure arrays and magnetic-field values refer to the same nonempty sample set and share an exact shape.
The caller has decided that a pointwise sampled firehose-margin value is the quantity it needs; this asset performs no scientific preflight of its own.
supported: Finite scalar and array sample sets of any B pattern, including a single sample and all-equal B values.
Callers that need only the pointwise margin and must not trigger a set-dependent mirror branch or a sampled-minimum stability flag.
excluded: A mirror-instability margin, any p_perp derivative, any cross-sample or spatially resolved criterion.
A stability verdict: no stable flag exists, and positivity of the returned values is not asserted or interpreted by this asset.
Kinetic or finite-Larmor firehose corrections, growth rates and full equilibrium stability proofs.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for mismatched shape, an empty sample set, nonfinite pressures/field, a non-scalar mu0, or nonpositive/nonfinite mu0.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if the margin becomes nonfinite (float64 overflow of B^2/mu0); other unexpected NumPy conversion errors may propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; no iteration is performed.
failure_semantics.partial_results: None; the single margin field is returned only on success.

provenance.lineage_summary: SciRel maintains this pointwise relation as an independent decomposition of its own maintained firehose/mirror margin diagnostic, not as a migration of saved source material: the 2026-09-27 outbound evaluations (flat-B holdout and JSON-snapshot states) showed autonomous callers invoking the combined diagnostic on one-sample states whose mirror branch premise (a genuine B-value scan) is absent, so a separate relation exposing only the pointwise margin was added. The pointwise algebraic margin itself was already public through the combined diagnostic's firehose_margin field; this asset changes no numeric contract and adds no new source intake.
source_kinds: SciRel direct formula and failure-behavior regression tests
SciRel outbound evaluation evidence (2026-09-27 flat-B and state-json holdouts, development records)

example.description: Evaluate the pointwise margin for a single sample and for an unsorted array, with no derivative or flag anywhere in the contract.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.diagnostics import compute_pointwise_firehose_margin
mu0 = 4.0e-7 * np.pi
single = compute_pointwise_firehose_margin(810000.0, 740000.0, 0.93)
assert float(single['firehose_margin']) == 0.93 ** 2 / mu0 + 740000.0 - 810000.0
B = np.array([2.0, 1.0, 3.0, 1.5])
p_perp = 5.0 + 3.0 * B
r = compute_pointwise_firehose_margin(p_perp - 2.0, p_perp, B)
np.testing.assert_allclose(r['firehose_margin'], B * B / mu0 + 2.0)
assert set(r.keys()) == {'firehose_margin'}
example.expected: The one-sample state yields the elementwise algebraic value directly (the one-sample case from the 2026-09-27 holdout evidence); the unsorted array reproduces the combined diagnostic's pointwise firehose_margin field exactly while the result contains no mirror, minimum or stable fields.

scope: Elementwise closed-form identity for scalars and arrays, equality with the combined diagnostic's firehose_margin field, and faithful negative-margin return.
One-sample and all-equal-B validity, invalid-input rejections (shape, empty, nonfinite, non-scalar mu0, mu0) and the overflow gate.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct SciRel tests establish the listed algebraic identity and failure behavior only. They do not establish a current qualified source oracle, a complete firehose instability criterion, any mirror-instability information, physical stability of any state, or expert scientific approval.
known_limitations: The returned value is an arithmetic observation; no positivity label, criterion statement or stability meaning is provided by this asset.
The relation is the local fluid-ordering firehose discriminant; gradient-driven, kinetic and finite-Larmor corrections are not represented.

The relation family also contains the combined firehose/mirror diagnostic with a documented one-sample zero-derivative mirror convention; callers must select by contract, and this asset exists precisely so that one-sample states need not touch that convention.
Public distribution licensing and expert recognition remain pending.
